findings.title: Uncaught sessionStorage SecurityError in PortalShell crashes portal into Next.js ErrorPage
findings.proposedFix: Wrap sessionStorage access inside try { ... } catch { /* ignore storage denial */ } matching live-session.tsx.

findings.title: ?v2=1 entry query opt-in does not survive Login router.push('/patient') or subroute navigation
findings.proposedFix: Persist ?v2=1 to guarded sessionStorage on entry/PortalShell mount or remove query-param opt-in and document sessionStorage-only activation.

findings.title: DoctorDemoV2 consultation summary writes to Consultation.notes, which createDemoAdapter.record() strips for Patient
findings.proposedFix: Map released patient summary to a shareable Consultation field (e.g. instructions/followUp/diagnosis) or add an explicit shareable summary input distinct from private notes.

findings.title: ui-v2-read-surfaces.test.mjs silently bypasses DemoV2Router handoff; test-ui-browser.mjs hardcodes /tmp report path
evidenceRefs: Static AST evaluation omits DemoV2Router binding so typeof DemoV2Router === 'function' evaluates false; /tmp/eh-v2-ci-browser-report.json is POSIX-specific.
findings.proposedFix: Bind DemoV2Router or add explicit V2 handoff assertion in read-surfaces/shell-integration, and use os.tmpdir() in test-ui-browser.mjs.

findings.title: Fixed plural labels for count=1 and unlocalized appointment/availability status pills in Arabic
findings.proposedFix: Use count-aware singular/plural EN/AR copy and pass Patient/Doctor statuses through localized label mapping.

findings.title: Active toast message stays in prior locale after switching EN <-> AR
findings.proposedFix: Clear toast on locale change or store locale-independent message keys.

findings.title: Unknown /patient/doctors/:id falls back to first provider's slots; /doctor/consultation/:id ignores :id; unmatched subroutes fall through to Home
evidenceRefs: Source audit of PatientDemoV2 and DoctorDemoV2 routing conditions.
findings.proposedFix: Suppress selectedProvider fallback when doctorRouteId does not match any provider; initialize selectedId from /doctor/consultation/:id.

findings.title: Heading level skips (h1 -> h3) on card lists and missing ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation on Lab tablist
evidenceRefs: Source audit of JSX heading hierarchy and ARIA tablist controls.
findings.proposedFix: Add section headings (h2) or normalize card headings, and add Left/Right arrow key roving focus on LaboratoryDemoV2 tabs.

findings.title: Gateway .heroSvg lacks dark fallback background if care-encounter.webp fails in Light mode; Doctor schedule shows booking-time patientName after Settings edit; fresh Gateway->Doctor Consultation has empty appointments
findings.proposedFix: Add dark fallback background-color on .heroVisualPane; optionally document fixture separation vs dynamic profile.
